headline: Prompt Engineering vs Loop Engineering vs Graph Engineering: What Changes at Each Layer
context: Three terms now compete for the same line in AI engineering job descriptions. Prompt engineering is the established one. Loop engineering entered the AI vocabulary in late 2025 and dominated developer discussion through June 2026. Graph engineering followed roughly six weeks late
